hero.title: Build systems that
hero.description: We're building a culture focused on engineering quality, systems thinking and long-term technical excellence.

culture.title: Engineering Culture
culture.subtitle: The principles and values that define how we work and build together.

quality.title: Engineering Quality
quality.description: We prioritize clean, maintainable code over quick fixes. Every line of code is written with future developers in mind.

systems.title: Systems Thinking
systems.description: We approach problems holistically, understanding how components interact and influence each other across the system.

remote.title: Remote-First
remote.description: Work from anywhere. We believe great engineering happens when people have the freedom to structure their own environment.

product.title: Product Mindset
product.description: Engineering exists to serve products and users. We make technical decisions that create real business value.

longTerm.title: Long-term Architecture
longTerm.description: We build systems designed for the next 5 years, not just the next sprint. Sustainability is not optional.

learning.title: Continuous Learning
learning.description: The frontend ecosystem evolves rapidly. We dedicate time to research, experimentation, and skill development.

standards.title: Technical Standards
standards.subtitle: Our engineering standards ensure consistency, quality, and maintainability across all projects.

architecture.title: Architecture Before Implementation
architecture.description: We spend time understanding the problem space and designing solutions before writing code. This upfront investment pays dividends in long-term maintainability.

outcomes.title: Outcomes Over Output
outcomes.description: We measure success by impact, not lines of code. The best solution is often the simplest one that achieves the desired outcome.

ownership.title: Ownership and Accountability
ownership.description: Engineers own their work end-to-end. From design to deployment to monitoring, we take responsibility for the systems we build.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Sharing
knowledge.description: We document decisions, share learnings, and invest in making our teammates better. No knowledge silos allowed.

openings.title: Join Our Team
openings.emptySub: We're always interested in connecting with talented engineers.
